text: Gulf Oil International, the McLaren F1 team partner, is part of the Hinduja Group, the family-owned conglomerate that has controlled the Gulf brand (outside the US, Spain and Portugal) since acquiring it from Chevron in 1984.

source.name: Gulf Oil International - About us (Hinduja Group)
source.quote: Gulf is a part of the Hinduja Group, one of the world's largest and most diverse business conglomerates. The Hinduja Group is a family business that has been in operation since 1914
